message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on a fiber terminal box of plastic. Likely candidates are 3926.90.99 (other articles of plastics), 8538.90 (parts of switchgear apparatus), and 8547.90 (insulating fittings). It has no electrical components and is an empty enclosure for fiber optic cables, so a plastic article classification seems most likely. I recall similar rulings for empty plastic enclosures going to 3926.90.99. Electrical boxes of plastic fall under 3925.90 only for builders' ware, and 8536.90 or 8538.90 don't fit an empty box that houses fiber optic connections. Fiber optic enclosures were ruled 3926.90.9990 in several rulings, so I'll go with that.
